drivingQuestion: What case does the mishna's זה הכלל come to include for vows of assessment?
outcomeNote: A one-line gloss mirroring the one given earlier for valuations, uncontested.

segments.he: זֶה הַכְּלָל: דָּבָר שֶׁהַנְּשָׁמָה תְּלוּיָה בּוֹ, לְאֵתוֹיֵי מִן הָאַרְכּוּבָּה וּלְמַעְלָה.
segments.en: The mishna further teaches that «this is the principle:» One who takes a vow of assessment with regard to «an item upon which the soul is dependent» gives the assessment of his entire self. The Gemara explains that the phrase: This is the principle, serves «to include» one who vowed to donate the assessment of his leg «from the knee and above.» Since one would die if his leg were severed above the knee, this is an item upon which the soul depends, and therefore he gives the assessment of his entire self.

moves.cueHe: זה הכלל: דבר שהנשמה תלויה בו, לאתויי מן הארכובה ולמעלה
moves.summary: glosses the mishna's generalizing clause for assessments as including a leg from the knee upward
moves.about: quoting the mishna's generalizing clause, this time in the assessment half of the mishna
